name: Sleep window lock
description: Keep a consistent sleep/wake window. Highest-ROI recovery lever when training is already hard and the job is demanding.
med: Stay within ±30 minutes of target bedtime and wake time
highIntensity: Fixed bedtime, dark/cool room, same wake time including weekends

name: Targeted mobility block
description: Short daily mobility focused on hips, T-spine, and shoulders to offset desk work and heavy training—not another workout.
highIntensity: 20 minutes including soft tissue work

name: Zone-2 / easy recovery
description: Easy aerobic work that aids recovery without competing with hard training sessions.
highIntensity: 45–60 minutes true Zone-2

name: Stimulant + screen cutoff
description: Protect sleep quality under job stress with caffeine timing and evening wind-down rules.
highIntensity: Full wind-down ritual: no stimulating screens last 60 minutes

name: Training auto-reg log
description: Weekly check of sleep, soreness, and motivation; adjust next week’s volume so you don’t grind into injury.
highIntensity: Scores plus explicit volume/intensity adjustment for next week

name: Protected deep-work block
description: One uninterrupted block on the highest-leverage technical task. Phone away, chat snoozed, single outcome defined before start.
med: 45 minutes, one clear outcome, notifications off
highIntensity: Two 90-minute blocks with a written shutdown between

name: Weak-skill deliberate practice
description: Focused drill on a known weak skill (system design, algorithm pattern, tool fluency)—not passive content consumption.
med: 25-minute focused drill with one failure mode
highIntensity: 60 minutes plus a feedback artifact (review notes or recorded attempt)

name: Hard technical reading
description: Read material above comfort level: papers, RFCs, deep chapters—not news or shallow blogs.
highIntensity: Full paper or chapter with written notes

name: Spaced system review
description: Short spaced review of notes, flashcards, or system knowledge so job context-switching doesn’t rot skills.
highIntensity: 20 minutes including rewrite of weak cards/notes

name: Write-to-clarify
description: Force clarity by writing a decision memo, design note, or explanation. Dual asset for thinking and career.
highIntensity: Publishable note or post

name: High-leverage outreach
description: Send thoughtful outbound messages to people who matter for learning, work, or opportunity—not generic networking spam.
med: One thoughtful message with a clear reason
highIntensity: Three messages including one specific ask

name: Relationship CRM pass
description: Weekly scan of key relationships and scheduled next touches. Systems fix the professional habit of forgetting people.
highIntensity: Full list review and calendar next touches

name: 1:1 outside immediate team
description: Conversation with someone outside your day-to-day team to build weak ties and cross-domain information.
highIntensity: In-person coffee or meal

name: Same-day follow-up
description: Close open loops the same day: thank-yous, action items, promised intros. Reputation compounder.
med: One follow-up that would otherwise slip
highIntensity: Clear all open social/professional loops

name: Host or contribute in public
description: Show up in a community with real value: useful thread, OSS help, or hosting—not empty networking events.
med: One high-signal public reply or contribution
highIntensity: Run a session or ship meaningful OSS/community help

name: Weekly money review
description: Check balances, burn, and runway. Awareness before optimization.
highIntensity: Full personal P&L and runway update

name: Surplus allocation rule
description: Confirm automated surplus allocation (invest/save). Automation beats weekly willpower.
highIntensity: Rebalance or increase contribution rate

name: Finance admin batch
description: Batch bills, receipts, and financial inbox so admin drag doesn’t silently accumulate.
highIntensity: Taxes, docs, or multi-account catch-up

name: Compensation / market hygiene
description: Stay calibrated on market rate and compensation levers. Tech careers under-earn without intentionality.
highIntensity: One concrete move: doc ask, negotiation prep, or side-leverage research

name: Targeted spend audit
description: Audit one spend category and cut or renegotiate something real—not generic budgeting theater.
highIntensity: Cut or renegotiate one line item

name: Daily top-3 force rank
description: Name the three outcomes that matter today and kill or defer the rest. Protects deep work from a reactive job.
med: Three ranked bullets before starting work
highIntensity: Ranked top-3 plus explicit kill list

name: Ship one visible unit
description: Ship something others can see: PR, doc, demo, or decision. Progress is shipped, not busy.
highIntensity: User-visible or stakeholder-visible ship

name: Solicit hard feedback
description: Ask for specific, critical feedback on a work product—not vague “how am I doing?”
highIntensity: Structured review of a work product with written takeaways

name: Stakeholder comms batch
description: Proactive status and risk updates in a batch so senior signal doesn’t require meetings all day.
highIntensity: Proactive status plus explicit risk callouts

name: Career-capital artifact
description: Build optionality outside the current role: portfolio piece, OSS, talk outline, or public write-up.
med: 30 minutes on portfolio, OSS, or talk outline
highIntensity: Publish or present something

name: Non-job creative practice
description: Create in a domain that is not your job (music, drawing, writing, craft). Prevents pure-optimization identity collapse.
highIntensity: 60 minutes uninterrupted

name: Side project deep hour
description: One focused hour on a side project with real stakes—often feeds career and intelligence without being pure work.
highIntensity: Two-hour deep block

name: Unoptimized play
description: Leisure with no productivity angle. Recovery for high-agency people who only “rest” productively.
highIntensity: Half-day deliberately unoptimized

name: Novel high-quality input
description: Consume one high-quality novel input (film, essay, exhibit, album)—not doomscroll—to feed creativity.
med: One film, long essay, or exhibit
highIntensity: Experience plus active notes afterward

name: Make something for a person
description: Make a small gift, tool, note, or artifact for a specific person. Creative + social dual hit; anti-isolation.
med: Small gift, note, or useful tool
highIntensity: Substantial artifact delivered
